errors.evidence: The description states that the line for Claude-3.5-Sonnet decreases from its starting point. However, the line first increases from an accuracy of 26.7% at a tree width of 1 to 27.8% at a tree width of 3, before then decreasing. Characterizing the overall trend as a decrease is a misrepresentation.
